description: Input: the same fields as quote_video, plus attempt. Generate one silent clip (paid): a NEW run of skill generate_video, charged unit_credits per second of duration_s once it is delivered. Modes: text; first_frame (first_frame, optional last_frame, of the requested aspect ratio within 2%); reference (1 to 4 references). Call quote_video first and show the user the price. Call get_run with its poll.arguments; once it succeeded, generation.url is the clip. A reference is {upload_id, rights_confirmed: true} for a picture from upload_image or create_upload (rights_confirmed states you may use the people and works in it), {run_id} of a succeeded generate_image run of this account until its reusable_until, or {asset_id} of a picture asset from create_asset, whose rights were confirmed when it was made. A generation that fails is charged nothing. An identical request returns the same run it started before, so a call repeated after a lost answer starts nothing new; to make another one with the same request on purpose, pass attempt 2. While generations are closed it answers generations_disabled or generations_marking_pending and charges nothing. Price: 3 to 90 credits per second of clip, by model and size. Quote first with quote_video; list_prices names every price.
name: generate_video
title: Generate a clip
